verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Ghostty supports multiple windows, each with its own tabs and splits, rendered with native UI components. A runtime probe confirms bindable `new_split` and `new_tab` actions, which can be mapped through the keybind system, so panes and tabs work without an external multiplexer. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of pane navigation, resizing and layout management, and independent community corroboration of the splits and tabs workflow.
